main_prompt.goal: Recreate the requested composition using the main avatar identity, specified pose, outfit, and background; keep the result photorealistic and match the requested lighting.

rules.reference_priority: Latest explicit instructions > avatar identity > pose reference > outfit reference > background reference > defaults, with explicit attribute overrides respected.
rules.identity: Preserve the avatar face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, and skin tone except attributes explicitly requested to change.
rules.lighting: Select flash according to explicit instructions, time of day, ambient brightness, and camera type.
rules.camera: Use coherent framing and recommended generation settings; do not claim to have read EXIF metadata.

identity_lock.instruction: Use the exact same facial identity as the avatar reference, without copying the pose-reference model's face.

detail_character.makeup_style: Natural glowy makeup with realistic skin texture
detail_character.expression: Describe the exact eyes, mouth, gaze direction, and mood
detail_character.pose: Describe body orientation, head placement, arms, legs, and gesture
detail_character.outfits: Describe selected reference clothing, cut, fabric, fit, and accessories

detail_photo_style.background: Describe the reference setting and spatial details
detail_photo_style.lighting: Describe direction, source, softness, ambient brightness, and flash conditions
detail_photo_style.colour_grading: Describe warmth/coolness, saturation, contrast, and color cast
detail_photo_style.vibe: Describe the mood in photographic rather than abstract terms

detail_camera.camera_type: Smartphone front camera / smartphone back camera / professional camera
detail_camera.camera_angle: Describe view angle, tilt, subject direction, and perspective

main_prompt.negative_prompt: wrong facial identity, face swap artifacts, incorrect anatomy, extra fingers, duplicate limbs, plastic skin, oversharpening, cartoon style, watermark, text
